hold_reasons: Four author identities, two institutionally verified affiliations, contact details, a corresponding author, and all four checksum-valid ORCIDs are bound. The authors declare no external funding, no prior-publication obligation, and no concurrent submission. Author contribution/conflict, organizational-unit confirmation, institutional approvals, truthful generated-content disclosure, and live portal fields remain unresolved for submission.
Raw official page bytes were unavailable through the read-only web interface, so official page SHA-256 values could not be recorded.
No submission action or portal verification was performed.

The manuscript uses the supplied IEEEtran letterpaper journal author template and contains fourteen pages under the user-locked internal contract. Accessible official Computer Society guidance establishes a twelve-page MOPC threshold and says submission limits may differ, but an explicit live TSE initial-submission hard cap was not verified; recheck the portal before upload.
